TooltipSet.Property: Base color texture. Its alpha channel contributes to final opacity.
Opacity mask. White preserves opacity and black removes it.
Overall opacity multiplier. 0 is fully transparent; 1 preserves the texture and mask opacity.
Opacity threshold used when alpha cutoff is enabled. Higher values remove more low-alpha pixels.
Controls alpha clipping: Off keeps blended pixels, On uses a hard cutoff, and Smooth fades around the cutoff when available.
Controls whether visible transparent pixels write to the depth buffer. Enable it to improve sorting; disable it for layered transparency.
TooltipSet.Category: Textures used for color, normal detail, masks, and emission.
Transparency, culling, depth, and alpha-cutoff controls.
